title: Sunnat vs Nafl: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Asal mein Sunnat aur Nafl ka farq bohat aasan hai. Sunnat wo ibadat hai jo Nabi Kareem sallallahu alaihi wasallam ne hamesha ki hai. Aur humein bhi is ki hidayat farmayi hai. Isey bina kisi wajah ke chhorna ghalti hai. Ab Nafl ki baat karte hain. Nafl poori tarah aap ki apni khushi par hai. Isey na parhne par koi pakad nahi hoti. Bas farq ye hai ke Sunnat Farz ki kami poori karti hai. Aur Nafl se darjaat buland hote hain.
